item.text:
**5B.5 Research Note**

Marcos’s 2024 record is **mostly pro-cleanup and anti-rent**, with a real but limited caveat: connected-family and elite networks remained visible, especially in media/business crossovers. I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence of a major Marcos-family sweetheart-contract scandal or a clear monopoly grant; the negative case is more about residual oligarchic influence than direct presidential favoritism.

| Claim-level item | Publisher | Date | Recoverable page URL | Short claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| **PBBM Signs Laws on Streamlining Procurement, Combatting Online Scams** | Presidential Communications Office | July 20, 2024 | https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/ | The New Government Procurement Act streamlined procurement, standardized forms, and institutionalized e-procurement, which directly reduces opportunities for favoritism and graft. | 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.3 |
| **DBM: New Gov’t Procurement Act is biggest anti-graft, corruption law** | Philippine News Agency | July 23, 2024 | https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1229591 | DBM explicitly framed the procurement law as a major anti-graft measure, supporting the interpretation that Marcos backed cleaner public contracting rules. | 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.3 |
| **Philippines’ Marcos orders closure of offshore gaming industry** | Reuters / ThePrint | July 22, 2024 | https://theprint.in/world/philippines-marcos-orders-closure-of-offshore-gaming-industry/2185347/ | Marcos said the POGO sector had become associated with financial scamming, money laundering, trafficking, kidnapping, torture, and murder, and ordered it wound down. This is strong anti-rent, anti-crony evidence. | 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.1 |
| **PBBM orders immediate ban of POGOs, IGLs, other offshore gaming ops** | Philippine News Agency | November 8, 2024 | https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1237414 | EO 74 formally banned offshore gaming operations, including illegal ones, on public-order and rule-of-law grounds. This is the clearest formal anti-rent / anti-crime move I found. | 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.1 |
| **Philippines' Marcos signs tax reform law to lure foreign investment** | Reuters / Investing.com | November 10, 2024 | https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/philippines-marcos-signs-tax-reform-law-to-lure-foreign-investment-3713493 | The CREATE MORE law lowered corporate taxes and expanded incentives for qualified firms, which supports a more predictable business environment but also uses selective incentives rather than pure neutrality. | 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.3 |
| **PBBM’s economic group eases bottlenecks on offshore wind projects** | Presidential Communications Office | 2024 | https://mirror.pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbms-economic-group-eases-bottlenecks-on-offshore-wind-projects-inbox-presidential-news-desk/ | Marcos’s economic team removed investment bottlenecks for offshore wind, which is pro-investment and consistent with resisting insider barriers to entry. | 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.3 |
| **Philippines | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism** | June 17, 2024 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines | The report notes that ABS-CBN’s TeleRadyo Serbisyo entered a joint venture with Prime Media Holdings associated with Speaker Martin Romualdez’s family, broadening the Romualdezes’ footprint in media. This is not proof of a Marcos-directed payoff, but it is the best 2024 indicator I found of politically connected business expansion under the administration. | 5B.5, 5B.2, 5B.6 |

**Synthesis**
- Strongest positive evidence: procurement reform, POGO closure, tax/investment reform, and offshore-wind bottleneck removal.
- Strongest negative evidence: elite families still expanded footprints in connected sectors, but the evidence is indirect and mostly media-related rather than a clear corruption case.
- Search gap: I found **no strong 2024 evidence** of Marcos personally granting monopoly rights, exclusive contracts, or direct family enrichment through state policy. The record supports a **moderate anti-corruption / anti-capture** reading, not a clean one.
